name: Picture
label: Short Span
lede: Natal Zaks spent a decade making sunlit house in Aarhus under other names, then released two double LPs of dub techno as Picture in 2026, and Pitchfork gave the second an 8.2.

eras.title: Eleven guys and a bunker
eras.text: Aarhus is a quiet city, and its house scene started as a group of friends who bought records together. Natal Zaks was in the middle of it, running a label with his brother and releasing as Central.

years.big: We were eleven guys and that was just too many
q: We don't plan, we just do.
years.src: XLR8R: Labels We Love, Regelbau · Jaeger Oslo: What's in a name, a Q&A with Central
years.h: Regelbau: a Facebook group, a WWII bunker, a first record
years.p: It began as record buyers splitting shipping costs online, moved into a bunker for parties, and a New Year's night there paid for the first release. Natal Zaks, who does the artwork, is one of four core members.
years.xp:
The name is the German word for the standardized WWII bunker where the parties were held. The founding four, per XLR8R, were Christoffer Kejlstrup (C.K.), Mathias Okholm (Manmade Deejay) and the brothers Milán Zaks (DJ Sports) and Natal Zaks (Central); parties started in 2014 to 2015 and the first official release came in summer 2015.

The line in the pull quote is Zaks explaining why the collective eventually split into people running labels and people running events. XLR8R's label profile has him describing the whole operation as unplanned.

years.h: Fresh Context: Central on Help, the label he runs with his brother
years.p: Natal Zaks records as Central on Help Recordings, which he co-founded with Milán Zaks, who records as [[DJ Sports|e546aa8d-31e3-4874-9420-ffba69d7ff16]].

yt: Central, Boiler Room x Dekmantel Festival DJ set
years.p: Amsterdam's Dekmantel issues Central's Political Dance #1 and #2, taking his house records beyond the Aarhus circle.

eras.title: The producer behind the voice
eras.text: Zaks keeps releasing under a string of names, puts out a double LP as Central, opens a club, and becomes the co-producer next to Erika de Casier on records for 4AD.

years.src: Inverted Audio: DJ Sports talks up debut album Modern Species
years.h: Milán's Modern Species lands on Firecracker Recordings
years.p: [[DJ Sports|e546aa8d-31e3-4874-9420-ffba69d7ff16]] releases the double 12-inch on Edinburgh's Firecracker Recordings. It sold out quickly, with a repress planned, per Inverted Audio.
years.xp: Milán Zaks describes Regelbau as a collective years back that shared a place and threw parties. In 2017 he named his brother Natal, Man-dee, pH 1 and Samir as the people sharing studio space.

years.src: Jaeger Oslo: Album of the week, Central, Om Dans · Passive/Aggressive: Central interview and mix
years.h: Om Dans: Central's double LP runs dance cuts into ambient interludes
years.p: Jaeger Oslo makes it album of the week and compares its minimalism to Robert Hood's Minimal Nation.
years.xp:
Jaeger Oslo hears layer on layer that builds a dense subterranean void. The Danish site Passive/Aggressive, interviewing Zaks in June 2019, lists it as his second album, on Help, and notes he had spent about three months in Tel Aviv making new material.

The same year he is credited as a collaborator on [[Erika de Casier|071409d0-ce21-4f03-a111-aec4dbc1590d]]'s debut, Essentials.

years.cap: Super, Aarhus. Photo credit to be found.
years.h: Central opens Super: club, bar, record shop, radio station
years.p: It takes over the former Tape venue in Aarhus, with the Regelbau crew around it.
years.xp: Truants reports that Super opened in 2020 as a bar, record shop, radio station and events space. Zaks says the club puts community safety and education alongside the parties.

years.cap: Erika de Casier, Sensational (4AD, 2021). Credit to be found.
years.src: Wikipedia: Sensational (Erika de Casier album) · Bandcamp Daily: Erika de Casier Lets Loose on Sensational · Truants: Truancy Volume 281, Central
years.h: Erika de Casier's Sensational, co-produced by Natal Zaks
years.p: 4AD releases the album; Zaks, who had worked on her 2019 debut Essentials, co-produces it and remixes under the name El Trick.
years.xp:
Wikipedia says de Casier co-produced Sensational with Zaks. Bandcamp Daily credits him with the upbeat, danceable beats on Busy and Better Than That. Pitchfork put the album at number 40 on its 50 best albums of 2021.

Zaks told Truants that each of the two albums took about a year: the first built around her voice, the second from demos she brought.

eras.title: Same producer, more names
eras.text: Under Central, Picture, Palta, Maizena and others, Zaks puts out records at a pace that keeps his label busy, and keeps working with de Casier.

q: Everything I make doesn't have a name until I release it.
years.src: CLONE distribution: Picture (AKA Central), Metric EP · Jaeger Oslo: What's in a name, a Q&A with Central
years.h: Metric EP: Natal Zaks records as Picture on Kalahari Oyster Cult
years.p: Four tracks: Rul, Silke, Forskudt and Targil. It is the earliest Picture release in our sources.
years.xp: CLONE lists it as Picture (AKA Central), catalogue OYSTER37, and describes four bouncy joints in the classic Aarhus style. Zaks has said he starts by dropping every concept, and that nothing he makes has a name until release.

years.src: Discogs: Central, Up And Down · Resident Advisor: Picture, Uuuuuuuu (review)
years.h: Up & Down: eight tracks recorded over four years
years.p: Central's double LP on Help Recordings, recorded and produced in Aarhus between 2018 and 2021 and mastered by Simon Davey.
years.xp: RA's Bella Aquilina later points to Lost Touch, from this record, as the place where traces of Zaks' dub techno interest already showed. Discogs lists it as HELP020.

years.src: Wikipedia: Still (Erika de Casier album) · Sound Shelter: The many faces of Natal Zaks (Central)
years.h: Natal Zaks mixes every track on Erika de Casier's Still
years.p: The 4AD album credits him with mixing all 14 tracks, plus programming and studio musicianship.
years.xp: Central also puts out Plask and Livet on Help this year, per Sound Shelter's list of his aliases and releases.

eras.title: Vowels and pressure
eras.text: Two double LPs in five months, both on a Sheffield label that started in 2025. The house grooves are gone; the low end and the reverb do the work.

years.src: Inverted Audio: Review, Picture, Eeeeeee · note.com: Emerging Dub Techno Label Short Span
years.h: Eeeeeeee: Picture's first record for Short Span
years.p: A double 12-inch that Inverted Audio's reviewer describes as piercing minimal techno and blown-out ambient.
years.xp:
Short Span is run by Matthew Kent out of Sheffield and started in 2025. Kent has said he moved toward dubbier records with long single sides after the pandemic.

Inverted Audio's reviewer reads Eeeeeeee as a record about numbness from the news cycle.

years.cap: Uuuuuuuu, Short Span, 2026. Artwork credited to Mammo.
years.src: Album of the Year: Picture, Uuuuuuuu · Resident Advisor: Picture, Uuuuuuuu (review) · Discogs: Picture, Uuuuuuuu · Bandcamp: Picture, Uuuuuuuu
years.h: Uuuuuuuu: seven tracks, 46 minutes, and an 8.2 from Pitchfork
years.p: Short Span issues the double 12-inch; Album of the Year lists Pitchfork's score as 82/100, from reviewer H.D. Angel.
years.xp:
Album of the Year quotes Angel: dub techno at a higher level on an energetic, atmospheric 2x12. RA's Bella Aquilina says there is still evolution inside the framework of dub techno, and hears heavy, crowded arrangements that keep moving.

The tracks are Quuuuuu, Ruuuuu, Miiiiiii, Leeeeeee, Peeeeeee, Ziiiiiiiii and Wooooooo. Mike Grinser mastered it, per Discogs. The artist's Bandcamp line for it is: back with more, still burning.

years.src: Word and Sound: Picture, Yyyyyyyyy · Cold Cuts Hot Wax: Picture, Yyyyyyyyy
years.h: Yyyyyyyyy: four more tracks on P-ton, 80 copies
years.p: A hand-stamped 12-inch that retailers describe as pristine dub techno in the Basic Channel line.
years.xp: Retailers Word and Sound and Cold Cuts Hot Wax both carry it as Picture, P-TON 03, and note Zaks as the Regelbau figure and Danish house producer Central.
